data.description: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a mu spore can release a cloud of burrowing spores in a 100-foot cone.  The burrowing spores deal 20d8 points of damage to all creatures and wooden structures in the area, or half damage to any creatures that make a DC %1 Reflex save.  Plants and plant creatures are immune to this damage.
